en.headline: 3 own commits plus 5 automated; 4 issue actions in openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 5 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits updated agent documentation to explain commit-attribution aliases and fixed the daily report so commit attribution supports aliases, including commits authored with non-GitHub account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single own commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5`. Issue activity totaled 4 actions, all in `openchamber/openchamber`: the user opened issue #4920 about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%; commented on issue #4111 about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied; and both commented on and closed issue #4346, which reported that `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passes after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. The user also joined an existing discussion, #4821 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel". No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or state changes were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交加 5 次自动提交；openchamber 中 4 次 issue 操作
zh.summary: 2026-10-15 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 5 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别更新了 agents 文档以说明提交归属别名，并修复了 daily 报告使提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次本人提交将版本标记为 `v1.15.5`。Issue 活动共 4 次，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber`：用户新开了 issue #4920，指出上下文面板的 breakdown 条用最后一条消息的输入去分整场估算，导致 `其他` 恒为 0%；在 issue #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；并对 issue #4346 留言后将其关闭，该 issue 反映 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍然通过。用户还参与了 `openchamber/openchamber` 中已有的讨论 #4821，标题为 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel"。当天没有 PR、review、release、star 或状态变更记录，也没有任何分区触及采集上限。
